# TikYouBot — TikTok Downloader Telegram Bot

> Free Telegram bot that downloads TikTok videos without watermark in seconds.
> Also supports Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Twitter and Facebook videos, plus
> TikTok photo posts with sound. No app install, no login required.

## Main page
- [TikTok Downloader Bot — No Watermark, Free](https://m1nuzz.github.io/tiktokrustbot/): landing page with how-it-works steps, supported platforms and FAQ.

## Bot
- [TikYouBot on Telegram](https://t.me/tikyoubot?start=site): send any TikTok, Instagram or YouTube Shorts link and receive the clean HD video.

## Source code
- [m1nuzz/tiktokrustbot on GitHub](https://github.com/m1nuzz/tiktokrustbot): open-source Rust bot (teloxide, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, SQLite).

## Contact
- Support and ideas: https://t.me/SuggestMeTokBot
